candidate.definition_en: Forward in time or space; continuing ahead.
candidate.explanation_ar: من الوقت ده وطالع (فصاعداً)، أو باتجاه الأمام.

senses.definition_en: Continuing forward in time from a particular point.
senses.definition_ar: من نقطة زمنية معينة فصاعداً في اتجاه المستقبل.
examples: The agreement applies from June onwards.
The records from the 18th century onwards are well preserved.

senses.definition_en: Continuing forward in space or movement; towards a point ahead.
senses.definition_ar: إلى الأمام في الحركة أو المكان.
examples: They marched onwards despite the fatigue.
The agreement applies from June onwards.
They marched onwards despite the fatigue.
The records from the 18th century onwards are well preserved.
candidate.mnemonic: فيها 'On' و 'Ward' 'اتجاه'.. يعني مكمل في الاتجاه ده 'Onwards'.
